metric: mAP50-95 at the saved best.pt epoch (keypoint mAP for court and player)
source: training results.csv in s3://<bucket>/weights/<name>/ for obj and court (best-fitness epoch); player: stock COCO-pretrained YOLO26-pose scored on COCO val2017 person keypoints (5000 images, Ultralytics val, FP16). CS692 notes section 15.

datasets.player: COCO val2017 person keypoints, 5000 images (not trained here; not comparable with obj or court)

app_models_source: the saved best.pt of each run in python/runs, i.e. the best-fitness epoch: detector box mAP50-95 0.725 at epoch 63; court keypoint mAP50-95 0.935 at epoch 144 (fitness combines box and keypoint metrics; the keypoint score alone peaked at 0.939 at epoch 134). The app's pose model is the stock yolo26n-pose, the same as player-n-640.
